cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office clock is taking us backward. Wonderful, you can make the meeting we missed. Remember when I had to teach you to use a diary?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too far. I haven't even received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent preparation time. For once you can work out what you want to say before I have to prompt you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss is asking if we need a meeting at all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Tell her no. You were always good at turning up; let's see you use what I taught you about speaking up.

reason: Make the former pupil relationship change the practical request, correction or interpretation. Preserve the useful original causal chain while repairing remote-audience knowledge and explicit bowl orientation.
